{"code": "import pandas as pd

def note_finding(message):
    print(f"[FINDING] {message}")

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify and exclude sentinel values
sentinel_value = -999.0
valid_baseline = data['biomarker_baseline'][data['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute mean of valid baseline values
mean_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()

# Report
print(f"Mean biomarker_baseline (excluding sentinel values): {mean_baseline}")"}
